protocol.title: Cross-sectional options implied-vol TERM-SLOPE basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative near-to-far ATM IV term slope) -> subsequent forward relative realized return kurtosis spread (ETH-minus-BTC forward return kurtosis spread): wrapper-free Spearman rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-118 (same causal term_slope reconstruction ``term_slope = IV(near) - IV(far)`` from the real Deribit option trade tape, reused verbatim) and EVAL-77 (same cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH alignment and ``_relative_signal_series``, reused verbatim) and EVAL-125 (same forward return-kurtosis target, reused verbatim) but a DISTINCT cell: the *cross-sectional term-slope basis* with forward *relative realized return kurtosis spread*; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the cross-sectional term-slope partner to EVAL-118 (term_slope basis -> relative return skewness spread) and EVAL-125 (term_ratio basis -> relative return kurtosis spread); both use the same sealed signal/target reconstructions. It makes a predictiveness claim only, no traded-form / monetization claim

cross_section.target: spread_k = forward_kurtosis[ETH](k+1..k+H) - forward_kurtosis[BTC](k+1..k+H) with forward kurtosis = fourth standardized moment m4 / m2**2 of log returns over the next H perp bars (strictly after the decision at bar k, ``_forward_return_kurtosis`` verbatim)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term slope from the real Deribit option trade tape (EVAL-74 ``_term_bars``): near-ATM trades grouped by expiry; term_slope = IV(near expiry) - IV(far expiry); the term_slope field is overlaid by bar_open_ms onto EVAL-77's common aligned cross-section; the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e77._relative_signal_series / e61.expanding_zscore).
protocol.target_detail: forward relative realized return kurtosis spread: per underlying forward kurtosis = fourth standardized moment m4 / m2**2 of log returns over the next H perp bars (strictly after the decision at bar k, ``_forward_return_kurtosis`` verbatim), then ETH minus BTC on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, spread_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, ETH term-slope-richness predicts ETH subsequently carries a richer forward return kurtosis spread relative to BTC)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative forward-return-kurtosis spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (term_slope basis x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: EVAL-126 consumes both underlyings' trade-tape IV surfaces and both perp series. It composes the sealed EVAL-74 term-structure floor (EVAL-71 surface floor + term adequacy: >= MIN_DISTINCT_EXPIRIES distinct near-ATM expiries with >= MIN_EXPIRY_TRADES trades each, and >= MIN_BARS_WITH_TERM bars carrying a term signal; applied to BOTH BTC and ETH, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with the sealed EVAL-77 cross-sectional alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a causal surface bar on the coarsest grid).
